summary: First end-to-end run of GSN Fresh Fish. Public GET endpoints, auth (login success/fail, /auth/me), admin CRUD, shop-status toggle, and full frontend E2E (homepage, admin login, add fish, toggle shop, logout) all working. Two backend concerns identified: (1) POST /api/auth/logout only clears refresh_token cookie; access_token remains valid so /api/auth/me continues to return 200 until expiry. (2) PUT /api/admin/fish/{id} rejects partial updates with 422 (requires full payload including name_en, name_mr). Both are backend behavior issues; frontend dashboard flow still works because it likely sends full payloads and cleans state on logout via client-side redirect.
passed: GET /api/fish returns 6 seeded fish with all required fields (id, name_en, name_mr, price_per_kg, available)
GET /api/settings returns owner_name, mobile, whatsapp, address, google_maps_url, business_hours
POST /api/auth/login (correct creds) returns user + sets access_token & refresh_token httpOnly cookies
GET /api/auth/me with cookie -> 200 user object; without cookie -> 401
POST /api/admin/fish, PUT /api/admin/fish/{id}, DELETE /api/admin/fish/{id}, PUT /api/admin/shop-status, PUT /api/admin/settings all return 401 without auth
POST /api/admin/fish (authed) creates fish; DELETE removes; changes reflected in public GET /api/fish (count 6->7->6)
PUT /api/admin/shop-status flips is_open; public endpoint reflects change; restored to true
Frontend homepage: shop-status-badge shows 'OPEN · सुरू', 6 fish cards, fab-whatsapp/call/maps all visible
Header 'Admin' link navigates to /admin login page
Login with admin@gsnfish.com / Admin@123 redirects to /admin/dashboard
Add Fish flow: dashboard 'Add Fish' opens modal, fields filled, new row appears in table
Toggle shop status in dashboard flips OPEN -> CLOSED and back to OPEN
Logout button returns to /admin login page

failed.issue: POST /api/auth/logout does not clear access_token cookie. Only refresh_token cookie is removed. Session remains valid for /api/auth/me and admin endpoints until access token expires.
failed.evidence: After curl POST /api/auth/logout with valid cookie jar (returns 200 {ok:true}), only refresh_token was removed from jar; access_token cookie persisted and subsequent GET /api/auth/me returned 200 with admin user.

failed.issue: PUT /api/admin/fish/{id} rejects partial updates. Endpoint uses non-optional Pydantic fields (name_en, name_mr) so a partial body like {"price_per_kg": 599} returns 422. Full payload works. Consider using a partial/Optional update schema for PUT (PATCH-like semantics).
failed.evidence: PUT with {price_per_kg:200} -> 422 with pydantic 'Field required' for name_en, name_mr. PUT with full body {name_en,name_mr,price_per_kg,available} -> 200.

action_items: In backend /api/auth/logout: also delete/expire the 'access_token' cookie (response.delete_cookie('access_token', path='/', ...)) alongside refresh_token.
Change PUT /api/admin/fish/{id} to accept an Optional/partial update model (all fields Optional) so partial updates like price-only work, or document/enforce that clients must send full payload.
